• About Us

    About Us

    Led by Founder Chairperson Smt. Nita M Ambani, Reliance Foundation was set up in 2010 to provide impetus to various philanthropic initiatives of Reliance Industries Limited.

    KNOW MORE

    • Our Chairperson
    • Our Story
    • What We do
    • Our Impact & Reach
    • Annual Report
    • Awards
    Our Chairperson

    Guiding our vision and initiatives is our esteemed Chairperson Smt. Nita Mukesh Ambani, whose leadership and vision inspire us to reach new heights. Her commitment to philanthropy and societal well-being sets the tone for Reliance Foundation's impactful contributions.

    Our Story

    Our journey is one of dedication, passion, and unwavering commitment. Founded with a vision to make a meaningful difference, Reliance Foundation's story is shaped by the collective efforts of a team dedicated to fostering positive change and creating lasting impact.

    Our Impact & Reach

    Driven by a commitment to measurable impact, Reliance Foundation's initiatives have touched the lives of millions across the country. Our extensive reach ensures that our efforts have a far-reaching and lasting effect on communities.

    Annual Report

    Explore our Annual Reports to gain insights into the progress, achievements, and challenges faced throughout the year. These reports provide a comprehensive overview of our initiatives and their impact on the ground.

    Awards

    Our dedication and impact have been acknowledged through various accolades and awards. These recognitions serve as a testament to our commitment to excellence and our continuous efforts to contribute positively to society.

    What We do

    Reliance Foundation engages in a wide spectrum of activities, from healthcare initiatives to educational programs, rural transformation projects, and disaster response. Our multifaceted approach is aimed at creating holistic and sustainable solutions.

  • What We Do

    What We Do

    Reliance Foundation is currently focusing on Rural Transformation, Health, Education, Sports for Development, Disaster Management, Women Empowerment, Arts, Culture & Heritage, Environment & Animal Welfare and Urban Renewal.

    KNOW MORE

    Rural Transformation

    Empowering some of the most marginalised communities across rural India with innovative and sustainable solutions since 2010.

    Education

    Education is at the heart of Reliance Foundation’s vision for India and central to the country’s social and economic progress.

    Health

    We believe that quality and affordable healthcare is crucial not only for communities but also for the economic and social well-being of India.

    Sports For Development

    At the heart of our sports initiatives, the goal is to cultivate lifelong learning, build character, and foster leadership skills among India's youth.

    Disaster Management

    Reliance Foundation’s Disaster Management programme supports vulnerable hotspots in building safer and disaster-resilient communities.

    Women Empowerment

    Empowered women mean a stronger and a better world and we are committed to empowering women to play a catalytic role in bringing change.

    Arts, Culture & Heritage

    Reliance Foundation is constantly reimagining ways to protect and promote Indian Arts, Culture & Heritage.

    Environment & Animal Welfare

    Creating a better world for all beings through Vantara — a landmark initiative for wildlife rescue, care and conservation, and community-linked sustainability across India

    Urban Renewal

    The Urban Renewal initiatives of Reliance Foundation strive to enrich and improve public spaces to improve the quality of life and infrastructure in cities.

  • Insights

    Insights

    Grounded in the ethos of "We Care," Reliance Foundation provides expert perspectives, compelling narratives through "Stories About Our Work," and thought-provoking analyses in our Publications, fostering understanding and driving informed decisions in the realm of social development.

    KNOW MORE

    • Publications
    • Stories About Our Work
    Publications

    Explore our publications for in-depth analyses, insightful findings, and thought provoking pieces. These materials contribute to the collective knowledge base, fostering discussions and driving informed decision-making in the social development space.

    Stories About Our Work

    Delve into the impactful narratives of our experts, as they share their experiences and perspectives on pressing issues. These stories provide a unique lens into the challenges faced, highlighting the depth of understanding and offering potential solutions for a better tomorrow.

    Experts Speak

    Our esteemed experts bring valuable insights to the forefront, addressing pressing issues with a depth of knowledge and perspectives. Their contributions aim to enhance understanding, offering profound insights into complex challenges and potential solutions.

    India and the SDGs

    Aligned with the nation's priorities, we channel our efforts towards addressing key developmental challenges in a diverse set of thematic areas like education, healthcare, rural development, sports, women empowerment, art and culture to name a few.

  • Careers

    Careers

    Embark on a fulfilling journey with us at Reliance Foundation, where a dynamic and collaborative work environment awaits, encouraging innovation and personal growth.

    KNOW MORE

    • Working At Reliance Foundation
    • Apply Now
    Working at Reliance Foundation

    Embark on a rewarding journey by joining our dedicated team at Reliance Foundation. We offer a dynamic and collaborative work environment that encourages innovation and values the contribution of each team member. Working here provides an opportunity to be a part of impactful initiatives, contributing to positive societal change and personal growth.

    Apply Now

    Take the first step towards a fulfilling career by applying to join Reliance Foundation. We welcome individuals who share our commitment to making a difference. Your skills and passion can contribute to our mission, creating a positive impact on communities and helping us achieve our vision for a better tomorrow.

  • Media

    Media

    Stay connected with Reliance Foundation to follow our journey, witness our initiatives, and experience the essence of positive change. Engage with us to stay informed and inspired.

    KNOW MORE

    • Media Releases
    • Videos
    • Events
    • Updates
    Media Releases

    Stay informed about our latest developments and contributions through our Media Releases. These releases provide detailed insights into our initiatives, achievements, and partnerships. We believe in transparent communication, and our media releases serve as a valuable source of information on our ongoing efforts

    Events

    Engage with our initiatives and witness the impact of our work by participating in our Events. From community engagements to awareness campaigns, our events showcase the diverse range of activities we undertake. Join us at these occasions to connect with our mission and be a part of creating positive change.

    Videos

    Immerse yourself in the visual stories of our initiatives through our Videos. These visual narratives provide a closer look at the lives impacted by our projects, offering a powerful and compelling portrayal of the positive transformations we strive to achieve. Watch and be inspired by the stories of change unfolding through our various endeavors.

    Updates

    Stay informed about the latest Reliance Foundation initiatives, including new scholarship and fellowship opportunities. Discover our progress in empowering communities and creating positive change.

Organisational Awards

2022-23
Best CSR Initiative Award at the India Digital Enabler Awards in the year 2022-23
2022-23
Reliance Foundation won the Olive Crown Award for its green initiatives in recognition of efforts as Green NGO of the Year (Silver) in the year 2022-23.
2022
Reliance Jio received CHRO Innovation award for its Khayal Rakhna initiative as the Best Employee Engagement Team of the Year.
2021
Reliance Foundation awarded the Golden Peacock award for CSR initiatives across the country in 2021.
2020-21
Reliance Industries Ltd was adjudged as the Best Corporate (Large category) in the 5th edition of the ICSI CSR Excellence awards in 2020-21.
2021
Reliance Foundation received the Gold Globee® Business Excellence 2021 Award for its Work from Home implementation, which includes Khayal Rakhna initiative.
2021
Reliance Foundation received ‘Award for Corporate Leadership in ESG (Environmental, Social, & Governance)’ from The CSR Journal – Excellence Awards 2021.
2021
Reliance received the Golden Peacock Award for Corporate Social Responsibility.
2020
Reliance Foundation won India Today-MDRA Special Healthgiri Award 2020 under Category “Best Far Reaching Corporate Contribution for a Wider Social Impact” during COVID-19.

Sports for Development

2021-2022
At the prestigious Annual Sportstar Aces Awards, Reliance Foundation was conferred the ‘Sports for Social Change (Chairperson’s Choice)’ Award instituted by The Hindu Media Group (for the year 2021-2022).
2021-2022
For its contribution towards promotion of sports, Reliance Foundation was awarded Rashtriya Khel Protsahan Puruskar by the Honourable President on the occasion of National Sports Day (for the year 2021-2022).
2018
Reliance Foundation won the FICCI India Sports award 2018 in the category of “Best NGO Promoting Sports” in the country.

Rural Transformation

2022
Reliance Foundation was conferred IAA Olive Crown Award 2022 under ‘Green NGO of year- Silver’ category for its green initiatives.
2021
Reliance Foundation received the CII DX Award 2021 under ‘Innovation in CSR through Digital Transformation” category for improving rural livelihoods.
2021
Reliance Foundation’s Machli App announced winner of World Summit Awards 2021 for providing digital solutions contributing to the achievement of the United Nations SDGs.
2020-21
“Machli”, AI-based Mobile Application for marine fisherfolk conferred mBillionth South Asia Award for the year of 2020-21 in the category ‘Agriculture & Environment’.
2019 & 2020
Reliance Foundation bagged the CII National Awards for Excellence in Water Management in the “Beyond the Fence” category for two consecutive years.
2019
Reliance Foundation was awarded the 10th AEGIS Graham Bell Award 2019 under the category of “Application for Social Good” for its mobile application ‘Machli’ for fisherfolk.
2017 & 2021
Reliance Foundation bestowed with mBillionth Award South Asia under Agriculture & Environment Category for its information services for two years.

Health

2023
Midday Maharashtra Gaurav Awards 2023 recognized Sir H. N. Reliance Foundation Hospital as the Best Multi-Specialty Hospital, Best Hospital for Multi-Organ Transplant in India.
2023
Elets Global Healthcare Summit & Awards 2023, Dubai recognized Sir H. N. Reliance Foundation Hospital as Excellence in Multi-Specialty Hospital in India, Excellence in Quality & Patient Satisfaction, Excellence in Robotic Surgery, Excellence in Multi Organ
2023
Times of India- Critical Care Ranking Hospital Survey, = Health Lifestyle Survey 2022 and - Multi-Specialty Hospitals Ranking Survey 2023 ranked Sir H. N. Reliance Foundation Hospital as the best hospital in Mumbai and Western India and ranked it as the 2nd best in the National level.
2022
Navbharat Healthcare Awards 2022 recognized Sir H. N. Reliance Foundation Hospital as Best Multi-Specialty Hospital in India and Best Hospital for Oncology, Advanced Bariatric & Laparoscopic Surgery, Cardiology, for Patient Care, for Orthopedics, Neurology, Urology and Digital Solutions.
2022
Mid-Day Health & Wellness Icons 2022 recognized Sir H. N. Reliance Foundation Hospital as Best Multi-Specialty Hospital, Best Hospital for Oncology, Best Hospital for Transplant Medicine, Best Hospital for Patient Safety & Satisfaction, Best Hospital for Orthopedics & Joint Replacement.
2022
Times Health Leaders Awards 2022 recognised Sir H. N. Reliance Foundation Hospital as Excellence in Multi-Specialty Hospital, Excellence in Multi Organ Transplant, Excellence in Onco Sciences, Excellence in Patient Safety & Satisfaction, Excellence in Cardiac Sciences, Excellence in Minimally Invasive & Bariatric Surgery.
2022
FE Healthcare Summit & Awards 2022, Delhi 2nd Edition ranked Sir H. N. Reliance Foundation Hospital as the Best Multi-Specialty Hospital, Best Hospital for Cardiology, for Organ Transplant, for Heart & Lung Transplant at the National level
2022
FE Healthcare Summit & Awards 2022, Delhi 2nd Edition ranked Sir H. N. Reliance Foundation Hospital as the Best Hospital for Heart & Lung Transplant in Mumbai and Western India
2022
ET Best Healthcare Brand Awards 2022 recognized Sir H. N. Reliance Foundation Hospital as ET Best Healthcare Brand 2022
2022
Mid-Day Health & Wellness Icons – International 2022 for Sir H. N. Reliance Foundation Hospital as the Best Multispecialty Hospital & Best Hospital by Transplant Medicine
2021-2022
Sir H.N. Reliance Foundation Hospital’s vaccination programme won the Best Vaccine Programme by a Private Hospital at the India Today Healthgiri awards for the year 2021-2022.
2021
Sir H.N. Reliance Foundation Hospital won the Mid Day Multispecialty Hospital Award for 2021.

COVID Response

2022-23
Hon’ble Governor of Andhra Pradesh & President, IRCS, Andhra Pradesh, State Branch awarded Gold Medal to Reliance Foundation for rendering services during COVID 19 pandemic in partnership with Indian Red Cross Society in the year 2022-23.
2022
Reliance Foundation Digital Extension Services for Disaster Management” selected for the CII – DX (Digital Transformation) Award 2022 - under the category of “Innovations in CSR”.
2021
Reliance Foundation was recognised as finalist under ‘INNOVATION@ COVID 19’ category and received a ‘certificate of recognition’ at mBillionth South Asia Award 2021 for its initiative on ‘Technology driven solutions for addressing supply chain and sustaining rural livelihoods’.

Women Empowerment

2022-23
Reliance Foundation was awarded the Best CSR Film award for Women Transforming Lives with Technology at the Socio-CSR Film Festival and Awards in the year 2022-23
